title: RLPolicy RobotPickPlaceComparison

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed RL policy comparison research task. Analyzed pick_place_metrics.csv comparing pi_base vs pi_new across 8 metrics in simulation and real-world. Generated comprehensive analysis with 7 visualizations, performed statistical evaluation, domain categorization, and risk assessment. Produced final report with clear recommendation against deploying pi_new due to critical safety regressions (350% increase in safety interventions, 84% increase in edge case failures) despite 11% efficiency improvements. All deliverables created: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and publication-quality report in report/ with figures in report/images/.
